name: DeepAI Code Runner
summary: Runs the DeepAI Code desktop app headless on a Linux host as a local AI worker pool: loopback web-mode server, tunnelable sign-in, one-time pairing, worker launcher with model fallback, and a model-scoped 429 cooldown ledger.
notice: This is a source descriptor for a locally-executed runner package. It defines no new workflow manifest format and makes no claim of a deployed Workflows runtime or MCP endpoint. The DeepAI Code application is upstream MIT software (DeepAI, t3code lineage); see NOTICE.md.

contract.discovery: headless DeepAI Code server surfaces: `auth session issue` (scoped short-lived bearer), orchestration HTTP API + WebSocket protocol, `server.getConfig` live model catalog

capabilities.name: headless-server
capabilities.surface: bin/deepai-runner-server.sh (loopback web mode, systemd user unit)

capabilities.name: worker-run
capabilities.surface: bin/deepai-worker-launcher.sh (scoped session in process memory, terminal-run streaming, JSON output)

capabilities.name: quota-cooldown-ledger
capabilities.surface: bin/deepai_quota.py (model-scoped 429 cooldowns; productization tracked in TavallStudios/tavall-ai#174)

verification.result: L0 syntax PASS (bash/node/python); L2 patch apply on the real 0.3.42 original bundle, quota ledger lifecycle and launcher error paths PASS; L3 real end-to-end probe deepai/glm-5.3-flash against the live headless server PASS. No full CI.

security.runtimeMode: DEEPAI_WORKER_RUNTIME_MODE defaults to auto; full-access is an explicit opt-in
security.approver: opt-in and title-scoped; full-access grant requires DEEPAI_AUTO_APPROVER_FULL_ACCESS=1
